title: Configuration count bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. Define its configuration bound by $(|Q|+1)(n+2)\,3^{k(2s+1)}(2s+1)^k$, where $Q$ is the state set of $M$.
